dialogues.speaker: Yuan Rong
dialogues.text: Gather round, gather round! If you're passing by, don't pass this up: Introducing the amazing Shadow Lantern!

response.speaker: Yuan Rong
response.text: It's a simple new invention of mine — all you have to do is rotate the objects inside the Shadow Lantern, get all the shadows to merge in a certain way, and the most incredible images will be revealed before your very eyes.

response.speaker: Yuan Rong
response.text: Intrigued? You should try it out for yourself! It's set up right here — please, peruse and use at your leisure.

response.speaker: Yuan Rong
response.text: No problem! I hope the Shadow Lantern shows you something truly spectacular.

response.speaker: Yuan Rong
response.text: Alright. If you've got the time, come back and give the Shadow Lantern a go!
